newsitem.title: JAPAN: DKB shares slide after prosecutors' raid.
newsitem.headline: DKB shares slide after prosecutors' raid.

text.p: Shares in Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd (DLB) slid on Wednesday morning, after Tokyo prosecutors raided the commercial bank on Tuesday in a widening investigation into links between financial firms and racketeers, traders said.
By 0029 GMT, DKB's shares had dropped 50 yen to trade at 1,340, making the bank the fourth largest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Turnover was 893,000 shares.
"The market was dragged down by the widening investigation of the racketeer scandal," one broker said.
But some brokers also said the prosecutors' raid on DKB was a selling factor for DKB shares alone and not for other bank shares.
